approvals.text:
Hi team, v2.3 is on staging. Please run the QA checklist for the upload flow.

1. Upload a file of type PNG at 0.8 MB from Safari, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

2. Upload a file of type JPEG at 1.6 MB from Chrome, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

3. Upload a file of type PDF at 2.4 MB from Firefox, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

4. Upload a file of type HEIC at 3.2 MB from Safari, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

5. Upload a file of type PNG at 4.0 MB from Chrome, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

6. Upload a file of type JPEG at 4.8 MB from Firefox, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

7. Upload a file of type PDF at 5.6 MB from Safari, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

8. Upload a file of type HEIC at 6.4 MB from Chrome, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

9. Upload a file of type PNG at 7.2 MB from Firefox, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

10. Upload a file of type JPEG at 8.0 MB from Safari, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

11. Upload a file of type PDF at 8.8 MB from Chrome, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

12. Upload a file of type HEIC at 9.6 MB from Firefox, refresh the page, and check that the preview, file name and size match what was uploaded.

Then try a 12 MB file: it should be refused with a clear message, and nothing should be stored.

Reply here with anything that looks off. Thanks!

✨ sᴇɴᴛ ᴠɪᴀ ᴄʟᴀᴜᴅᴇ
